name: Recall Kitchen
description: Hosted MCP for U.S. product recall search across CPSC, FDA food, FDA MedWatch, USDA, and NHTSA. Search by keyword, UPC, product name, or vehicle make/model; optional photo search. Free with an API key (X-API-Key or Bearer); anonymous x402 USDC on Base also works. Account tools (watches, inventory, notifications) need a key.
author: Recall Kitchen
